name: Dentelle Room
description: A pleated confectionery-paper frame, paired ribbon-wide portraits and a generous centred reading page.

name: Filament
description: An open literary page with a flowing italic heading and a fine spun-sugar line ornament.

name: Caissette
description: A portrait inset beside a narrow title column, opening into a full-width reply with a folded-paper foot.

name: Pralinograph
description: A paired portrait frieze with an inset nameplate and a low, wide title above an indented reading column.

name: Noisette Ledger
description: A letterpress-inspired page with a coloured double-rule masthead, an oversized initial-like ornament and small caramel grains.

name: Glacé Chat
description: A softly squared smartphone with a broad contact-photo header, a tiny offset camera and rounded received messages.

name: Prali-Slide
description: A compact slider handset with a recessed chat screen, a ridged sliding joint and a visible numeric keypad.

name: Bonbon Mail
description: A small desktop messenger window with a twin-avatar toolbar, window controls and neatly stacked chat bubbles.

name: Sucrose Touch
description: An angular slim phone with a contact tile, outlined message bubbles and an off-centre navigation wheel.

name: Pocket Temper
description: A compact wrist-device messenger with ribbed straps, a side crown and a tall rounded display.

name: Sugar Pleat
description: A miniature pleated note with a broad serif title and a fine member-colour paper edge.

name: Gossamer
description: A light asymmetric reply with a narrow portrait stamp and a threadlike loop at its foot.

name: Deux Bouchées
description: Two tiny portrait squares share a stepped confectionery-paper band above a compact reply.

name: Paillette
description: A horizontal miniature note with a small faceted sugar flake and a coloured title rail.

name: Pralinette
description: A tiny confectionery sleeve with a full-width photo lip, a folded name tab and a short reply.
